learned: 2026-10-05, by hand: Sapphire Farms' 'product' post type, brand=6 (Leal) and state=99 (New York) gives 72 products: 25 Flower, 22 Pre-Rolls, 6 Pre-Roll Multipacks (5g), 10 Ground Flower Packs, 8 Littles, 1 without a category. lealorganics.com redirects to sapphirefarms.com/brand/leal/.
notes: Titles are bare strain names, repeated across formats (slugs stank-breath, stank-breath-pre-rolls, stank-breath-3), so the format comes from the product-category class in class_list (product_type). brand=5 and brand=3 are Sapphire Farms' other brands; state=100 is Michigan.

Sizes: a Pre-Rolls page says 'Made with 1 gram of 100% Flower' under the title (a single 1g); a multipack is the category 'Pre-Roll Multipacks (5g)' (slug 5g-pre-roll-multipacks). Neither is in the API, so both are constants from the category, checked on the pages 2026-10-05.

Flower pages offer every strain as 'Eighths (3.5g), Quarters (7g), Ounces (28g)' without saying which a store has, but NY stores sell Leal flower as 7g bags only ('7g Flower | Animal Face (IH)', 'Flower Bag Super Boof (H)'; all four flower products at 2+ stores were 7g on 2026-10-05), so Flower is a constant 7g. If stores start selling an eighth or an ounce, it comes back from the stores' consensus (sizes must agree to match); recheck then.
Not catalogued: Littles and Ground Flower Packs pages state no size and no NY store sells them at 2+ stores.
One NY product has no category (Kush Cake, id 3015) and is skipped; spelling varies across formats ('Nic the Bruiser' / 'Nic The Bruiser', 'Sunset Sherbet' / 'Sunset Sherbert').

skip.why: littles, ground flower packs: no size on the site
